channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Pezeshkian says Iran ‘no longer trusts talks with Washington’
item.description: In an interview with Al Jazeera, the Iranian president says Qatar and Pakistan are relaying Tehran's messages to the US.

item.title: Trump ‘rejects’ Iran’s seven-day ceasefire proposal. What’s next?
item.description: Analysts say Trump may opt to resume attacks on Iran after November midterm elections.

item.title: Iran war squeezes Iraq’s economy as oil revenues fall and prices rise
item.description: Disrupted oil exports, costlier imports, and a weaker dinar expose Iraq's economic dependence on oil, foreign goods.

item.title: US official claims Trump holds all the cards in Iran talks
item.description: US State Department Spokesman Tommy Pigott says President Donald Trump ‘holds all of the cards’ in talks with Tehran.

item.title: Iran pitches US a seven-day end to the war at UNGA
item.description: Iran has pitched a proposal to open the Strait of Hormuz in seven days - if the US meets its conditions.

item.title: Iran offers US deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
item.description: Asked about the Iranian proposal, a US official told the BBC "constructive discussions" were taking place through mediators.

item.title: British national among six dead in building explosion close to Acropolis in Athens
item.description: Four Americans and a Greek national are among those killed in a suspected gas explosion, officials said.

item.title: Republic of Ireland confirm rescheduled news conference before controversial Israel game
item.description: The Republic of Ireland will now hold their delayed news conference at 14:30 BST before they face Israel in tomorrow's Nations League fixture in Hungary - a fixture campaigners have called on them to boycott.

item.title: What is kratom, the 'gas station heroin' alarming officials in the US?
item.description: Kratom, found during an investigation into the deaths of two college students, has been sold in the US for around a decade.

item.title: Why an international arrest warrant didn't stop Netanyahu's US trip
item.description: The BBC's Nada Tawfik explains why Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu was not arrested after speaking at the UN, despite an ICC arrest warrant.
